title: Did Vijay Varma post about reservation and privilege? Actor breaks silence on viral screenshot
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

For days, a widely shared screenshot of what was claimed to be Vijay Varma 's Instagram Story has been circulating on social media. In the post, the star appeared to share his views on reservation and privilege, triggering widespread discussion and debate across platforms. With the screenshot continuing to gain traction, Vijay has now addressed the widely shared claim.

Adding to this, Vijay Varma was last seen in Matka King. (Photo: Instagram) Vijay clarifies on X As the screenshot spread across social media, many people assumed it was genuine and attributed the views expressed in it to Vijay. The post quickly fuelled conversations online. However, as the speculation intensified, Vijay took to X, formerly known as Twitter , on Saturday to clear the air and address the widely shared claim.

Meanwhile, He reposted the widely shared screenshot, writing, “I never posted this. This is all false." The star reposted the screenshot again, reiterating his stance by sharing, “I never posted this. This is not my story.”

Notably, The text of the widely shared screenshot attributed to Vijay read, “My father bought a Maruti 800 when I was born. By the time I reached Class 12, he bought me a Honda Civic. I used to go to coaching in that car, while my best friend, who was from a Marwari family, still rode a 12 year old Hero Honda. We appeared for a government exam. He scored well but didn't get a seat. On the result day, he rode back home crying on his bike, while I was fine. I didn't need a reservation but he did. It was his right. If not, then atleast a fair chance was his right.”

As per the latest buzz, Meanwhile, Vijay has been vocal in expressing his support for the Cockroach Janta Party (CJP)-led student protests over the alleged NEET paper leak and examination irregularities. He also reacted to Union Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan 's resignation amid the student protests. The star shared an Instagram post following the announcement, using a lyric of the song Channa Mereya from Ae Dil Hai Mushkil movie.

In further updates, A Movie and Television Institute of India (FTII) graduate, Vijay appeared in small roles in Pink, Raag Desh, Manto, and Middle Class Abbayi, before he got his break with a small but talked-about role in Zoya Akhtar's Gully Boy. Over the last few years, Vijay has collected acclaim for his work in films and shows such as Darlings, Dahaad, and Mirzapur .

On top of that, He was last seen in Matka King. Set in 1960s Mumbai, the first season of Matka King revolved around an ambitious cotton trader who dreams of earning respect and legitimacy. He goes on to create a new gambling game called ‘Matka’, which soon takes over the city and changes a business that was once limited to the wealthy and influential. The show received positive reviews from both critics and audiences. Alongside Vijay Varma, the series also starred Kritika Kamra, Sai Tamhankar, Siddharth Jadhav, Bhupendra Jadawat and Gulshan Grover in important roles. Earlier this year, Prime Video officially renewed the show for a second season after the strong response to Matka King Season 1.

title: Govinda is a ‘bigger perfectionist’ than Aamir Khan, says his Hero No.1 co-star Shagufta Ali; here's why
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Bollywood star Aamir Khan is widely regarded as the industry's 'Mr Perfectionist'. However, veteran star Shagufta Ali believes Govinda is an even bigger perfectionist. Recalling their time together on the sets of Hero No. 1, she opened up that Govinda would often rehearse a scene up to 25 times and insist on multiple retakes until he was completely satisfied with the shot, even if it left his co-stars exhausted.

Adding to this, Shagufta explains why Govinda has a better eye for perfection than Aamir Khan. Shagufta Ali says Govinda is a perfectionist In a chat with Siddharth Kannan, Shagufta recalled how shooting for Hero No. 1 was like a paid holiday and shared, "We used to have great fun whether Govinda or Karisma were on the set or not. We were on a paid picnic. The outdoor shoot in Ooty was great. We had stayed at Mithun Da’s hotel. When he got to know about it, he came to meet us and treated us to seafood he personally cooked."

Meanwhile, She added, "Govinda used to come late on set here too. If the shift were 9 am, he would come by 1 or 2 pm, and never before that. This was the only issue with Govinda; otherwise he was a very nice person. I have done 3-4 films with him. He is a very nice person, fun-loving. He does 25 rehearsals. Govinda is a bigger perfectionist than Aamir Khan. David sir would okay the take, but he would still insist and also apologise to others. His eye for perfection was so strong that he didn’t care if the person opposite him was tired."

Notably, Shagufta also opened up that the late legendary comic star Kader Khan used to get angry whenever Govinda arrived late on set. She added that the other co-stars would also get irritated, but they had no choice except to wait for hours for Govinda to arrive every day.

As per the latest buzz, Govinda ruled Bollywood in the 1990s and was known for his unmatched comic timing, energetic dance moves and expressive performances. He rose to superstardom with a string of smash hit films such as Raja Babu, Coolie No. 1, Hero No. 1, Saajan Chale Sasural, Dulhe Raja, Bade Miyan Chote Miyan, Haseena Maan Jaayegi and Partner. His collaborations with director David Dhawan and actors such as Karisma Kapoor, Raveena Tandon and Kader Khan became hugely popular.

In further updates, However, the early 2000s saw a decline in his career. Although Partner (2007) marked a successful comeback, Govinda struggled to sustain the momentum. The star was last seen in Rangeela Raja, in which he played a double role. However, the movie failed at the ticket-window, and he has since stayed away from the big screen.

title: Suchitra Krishnamoorthi on co-parenting with ex-husband Shekhar Kapur: ‘He is the vacation dad, I’m responsible one’
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Star Suchitra Krishnamoorthi and filmmaker Shekhar Kapur got married in 1999 despite their 30-year age gap. However, their marriage ended in 2007. The two share a daughter, Kaveri Kapur, and in a recent podcast with Rediff Originals, Suchitra opened up about co-parenting her with Shekhar and revealed how they divided parenting responsibilities.

Adding to this, Suchitra Krishnamoorthi opens up about co-parenting with Shekhar Kapur. Suchitra Krishnamoorthi talks about co-parenting with Shekhar Kapur Suchitra reflected on the challenges she faced after her divorce, saying that she became the "poster girl" for divorce at a time when the subject was still considered taboo. She recalled being advised to stay quiet because people felt she was being too outspoken and feared she would offend others. However, she shared she has always believed in staying true to herself and has no regrets about speaking openly.

Meanwhile, Sharing her views on co-parenting, Suchitra shared that if separated couples can maintain an amicable relationship, it is in the child's best interests to receive love and support from both parents. She added that mothers and fathers each play unique and equally important roles in a child's life, and that children who have the presence of both are fortunate.

Notably, Talking about how she and Shekhar shared parenting responsibilities for their daughter, Kaveri, Suchitra revealed, "He’s the good cop. I’m the responsible one. I’m the full-time mum and he’s the holiday dad. Co-parenting comes with a lot of responsibility."

As per the latest buzz, She also admitted that after becoming a mother, she made a conscious decision to reject the parenting style she had experienced while growing up. She shared, "I had very strict parents. I always wanted to become the kindest mother in the world. Once Kaveri told me, ‘Mama, all the other mothers say no. You’re the only one who says yes to everything. You need to learn to say no.'"

In further updates, Suchitra opened up that she met Shekhar when she was just 19 years old and married him at the age of 22. The couple tied the knot in 1999 and welcomed their daughter, Kaveri Kapur, in 2001. However, their marriage ended in 2007. They have since continued to co-parent Kaveri. Kaveri made her Bollywood debut with the 2025 movie Bobby Aur Rishi Ki Love Story. Helmed by Kunal Kohli, the movie also starred Vardhan Puri in the lead role. The movie premiered on Disney+ Hotstar on February 11.

On top of that, Meanwhile, Suchitra rose to fame with her Bollywood debut in Kabhi Haan Kabhi Naa (1994) alongside Shah Rukh Khan. She went on to feature in films such as Aag, Rann, Romeo Akbar Walter, Jazbaa and several others. She was last seen in the 2022 movie Odd Couple and the Prime Video series Guilty Minds.

title: Jaaved Jaaferi on playing Manav in 'Dhamaal': Wanted him childlike, not caricaturish
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Mumbai, Star Jaaved Jaaferi, who is basking in the success of his latest movie "Dhamaal 4", says bringing his popular character Manav to life required careful attention to everything from costumes and voice to body language.

Adding to this, Jaaved Jaaferi on playing Manav in 'Dhamaal': Wanted him childlike, not caricaturish Directed by Indra Kumar, the "Dhamaal" franchise follows a group of eccentric friends whose quest for hidden treasure leads to a series of comic misadventures.

Meanwhile, The fourth instalment, which rolled out in theatres on June 10 and has collected over ₹ 145 crore rupees at the ticket-window, Jaaferi alongside Ajay Devgn, Riteish Deshmukh, Arshad Warsi and Sanjay Mishra.
Notably, Jaaferi reprises the role of Manav, simple-minded younger brother of Adi, played by Warsi. The two have been part of the franchise since the first part, which rolled out in 2007.
As per the latest buzz, Jaaferi shared sharing screen space with Warsi has always come naturally because of their decades-long friendship.

In further updates, "I've known him since he started his career as a dancer when he was 18. I've seen him grow. He used to come home and we've always shared a lot of love, affection and friendship. By the time we worked together, we already had that camaraderie," he told PTI in an interview.
On top of that, He still recalls the advice director Indra Kumar gave him after casting him as Manav in the first movie.

"Indu ji had told me he is childish, stupid but loyal. So I thought of the dungarees look and worked with the costume team to give him a unique appearance. But I didn't want it to become too caricaturish. It had to feel childlike, but with a certain balance," Jaaferi shared.

body: Here's what's trending across India right now:

Saptahik Rashifal (26 July to 1 August 2026): जुलाई महीने का यह अंतिम सप्ताह और अगस्त की शुरुआत सभी 12 राशियों के जातकों के जीवन में महत्वपूर्ण बदलाव लेकर आने वाली है. ग्रहों की बदलती चाल और नक्षत्रों के प्रभाव से यह सप्ताह करियर, व्यापार, आर्थिक स्थिति, लव लाइफ, पारिवारिक संबंध और सेहत के लिहाज से बेहद खास रहने वाला है.

Adding to this, इस सप्ताह कुछ राशियों के लिए नए अवसर और आर्थिक लाभ के प्रबल योग बन रहे हैं, वहीं कुछ जातकों को अपने स्वास्थ्य और वित्तीय फैसलों को लेकर विशेष सावधानी बरतने की सलाह दी जाती है. क्या इस सप्ताह आपको मिलेगी मनचाही सफलता? कैसा रहेगा आपका पारिवारिक और वैवाहिक जीवन? जानिए ज्योतिषाचार्य संजीत कुमार मिश्रा से सभी 12 राशियों का सटीक साप्ताहिक राशिफल और उनके अचूक उपाय.

Meanwhile, इस सप्ताह घर का वातावरण काफी सकारात्मक रहेगा. किसी शुभ समाचार से परिवार में खुशी का माहौल बन सकता है. परिवार के सदस्यों के साथ गुजारा हुआ समय आपको गहरी आत्मीयता और मानसिक शांति प्रदान करेगा.

Notably, कार्यक्षेत्र में आपकी सक्रियता और नेतृत्व क्षमता नई पहचान दिलाएगी. लंबे समय से लंबित प्रोजेक्ट पूरे होंगे, जिससे वरिष्ठ अधिकारियों का विश्वास मजबूत होगा. नौकरीपेशा लोगों को नई जिम्मेदारियां मिल सकती हैं. व्यापारियों के लिए नए बाजारों में प्रवेश का समय अनुकूल है. ऑनलाइन, तकनीकी और मार्केटिंग क्षेत्र वालों को विशेष लाभ मिलेगा.

As per the latest buzz, आपकी कार्यशैली में आत्मविश्वास और परिपक्वता दिखेगी, जिससे लोग आपकी सलाह पर भरोसा करेंगे. नई नौकरी या करियर बदलने की योजना बना रहे लोगों को सकारात्मक संकेत मिलेंगे. विद्यार्थियों को रुके हुए कार्यों में तेजी से प्रगति दिखेगी और पढ़ाई में मन लगेगा.

In further updates, आर्थिक मामलों में सोच-समझकर उठाया गया कदम लाभदायक रहेगा. किसी भी निवेश या साझेदारी में केवल उत्साह के आधार पर न बढ़ें. सभी तथ्यों की पड़ताल करें और भावनाओं की जगह व्यावहारिक सोच को प्राथमिकता दें.

On top of that, दांपत्य जीवन में सहयोग और विश्वास बढ़ेगा. जीवनसाथी का पूर्ण सहयोग रिश्तों में मिठास बनाए रखेगा. प्रेम संबंधों में भविष्य को लेकर गंभीर बातचीत हो सकती है. अविवाहित लोगों के लिए किसी सम्मानित पर���वार से शुभ प्रस्ताव आने के योग हैं.

स्वास्थ्य अच्छा रहेगा, लेकिन भागदौड़ के कारण शरीर को आराम की जरूरत होगी. सिरदर्द, रक्तचाप और मांसपेशियों के तनाव की समस्याओं को नजरअंदाज न करें. संतुलित भोजन, पानी और योग-प्राणायाम ऊर्जा बनाए रखने में सहायक सिद्ध होंगे.

title: “Ancient Buddhist Site of Sarnath” Inscribed in the UNESCO World Heritage List
body: Here's what's trending across India right now:

Today, in a remarkable decision taken at the 48 th Session of the World Heritage Committee being held at Busan, South Korea, India's official nomination for 2025-26 cycle, "Ancient Buddhist Site of Sarnath" got inscribed on the UNESCO World Heritage List, becoming India's 45th property to receive this recognition. This global accolade celebrates India's enduring cultural legacy, showcasing its diverse traditions of architectural brilliance, regional identity, and historical continuity.

Adding to this, Hon'ble Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi, Hon'ble Union Minister of Culture Shri Gajendra Singh Shekhawat along with Hon'ble Chief Minister of Uttar Pradesh Shri Yogi Adityanath lauded the historic milestone and congratulated the people of India for this achievement.
Meanwhile, Indian Delegation giving thanks speech at 48 th COM at Busan

Notably, The inscribed serial property comprises two component parts – Chaukhandi Stupa and the Archaeological Remains of Sarnath (Dhamekh Stupa, Dharmrajika Stupa, Mulagandgakuti Vihara, Ashokan Pillar, etc.) – located within Varanasi in Uttar Pradesh. Together these two components preserve the architectural and archaeological remains of the ancient site of Sarnath, known in the Buddhist tradition under different names – Rishipatana, Ishipatana, Mrigadava. They all refer to a sacred geography, where the Buddha visited in the 6th century BCE and delivered his first sermon known as the "Turning of the Wheel of the Law" ( Dharmachakra pravartana ). This event marked the inception of the Buddhist sangha and the establishment of the principles of the Noble Eightfold Path.

As per the latest buzz, Indicated by the Buddha himself to be one of the four key sites of Buddhist pilgrimage, Sarnath developed over centuries through royal, monastic and lay patronage. Numerous stupas, temples and viharas were constructed around what is believed to be the place of the first sermon of Gautama Buddha and the site where he met his first disciples. Having seen decline in the 12th century CE and subsequent destruction, it fell into obscurity until its re-discovery in the 18th century.

In further updates, The site comprises an ensemble of ancient monuments constructed from the pre-Mauryan period (5th-4th centuries BCE to 3rd century BCE) up until the destruction of Sarnath in the 12th century CE (with some later additions).

On top of that, Sarnath has been one of the most extensively excavated sites by the Archaeological Survey of India which resulted in a stratified settlement spread across 16 centuries (5th-4th centuries BCE to 12th century CE).

title: નવસારીઃ હેલિકૉપ્ટરથી પૂરનાં પાણી વચ્ચે ફસાયેલા શ્રમિકોનું રૅસ્ક્યૂ
body: Here's what's trending across India right now:

BBC News, ગુજરાતી કન્ટેન્ટ પર જાવ સમાચાર વીડિયો ઑડિયો વિભાગો સમાચાર ગુજરાત ભારત વિદેશ હવામાન સમાચાર સ્પોર્ટ્સ મૅગેઝિન લોકપ્રિય ગુજરાત ભારત વિદેશ હવામાન સમાચાર સ્પોર્ટ્સ મૅગેઝિન લોકપ્રિય નવસારીઃ હેલિકૉપ્ટરથી પૂરનાં પાણી વચ્ચે ફસાયેલા શ્રમિકોનું રૅસ્ક્યૂ Play video, "નવસારીઃ હેલિકૉપ્ટરથી પૂરના પાણી વચ્ચે ફસાયેલા શ્રમિકોનું રૅસ્ક્યૂ", અવધિ 0,50 00:50 વીડિયો કૅપ્શન, નવસારીઃ હેલિકૉપ્ટરથી પૂરના પાણી વચ્ચે ફસાયેલા શ્રમિકોનું રૅસ્ક્યૂ પ્રકાશિત 24 જુલાઈ 2026 વાંચવાનો સમય: 1 મિનિટ નવસારી જિલ્લામાં બિલિમોરા નજીક ગણદેવી તાલુકાના મેંધર ભાટ ગામમાં આવેલા ઝીંગા તળાવમાં કામ કરતા 28થી વધુ મજૂરો પૂરના પાણી વચ્ચે ફસાઈ ગયા હતા.
Adding to this, મદદ માટે તેમણે સોશિયલ મીડિયા પર વીડિયો શેર કરીને બચાવની અપીલ કરી હતી.
Meanwhile, છેલ્લા 24 કલાકથી તેઓ એક છાપરા પર આશરો લઈને બચાવની રાહ જોઈ રહ્યા હતા.
Notably, બચાવ દળોએ પરિસ્થિતિનું મૂલ્યાંકન કર્યા બાદ હેલિકોપ્ટરની મદદથી ઍરલિફ્ટ ઑપરેશન હાથ ધર્યું.

As per the latest buzz, ગુજરાત ચોમાસું શૉર્ટ વીડિયો છોડો અને આગળ વધો શૉર્ટ વીડિયો 00:47 વીડિયો , કેન્દ્રીય શિક્ષણ મંત્રી ધર્મેન્દ્ર પ્રધાને રાજીનામું આપ્યા બાદ શું કહ્યું? , અવધિ 0,47 01:17 વીડિયો , ધર્મેન્દ્ર પ્રધાનના રાજીનામા બાદ અભિજિત દીપકેએ શું કહ્યું? , અવધિ 1,17 00:45 વીડિયો , સુરત : ખાડી પૂરથી એવું પાણી ભરાયું સેંકડો બાઇક અને કાર પાણીમાં ડૂબ્યાં , અવધિ 0,45 00:48 વીડિયો , વડોદરા: તળાવ છલકાયું, તો લોકોના ઘરોમાં પાણીની સાથે સાપ ઘૂસી ગયા , અવધિ 0,48 00:39 વીડિયો , 'થૅન્ક યુ ફ્રૅન્ડ્સ' મોદીએ રાત્રે વધુ એક વીડિયો પોસ્ટ કરીને શું કહ્યું? , અવધિ 0,39 01:17 વીડિયો , Sonam Wangchuk એ વીડિયો પોસ્ટ કરીને કઈ વાતે આક્રોશ ઠાલવ્યો , અવધિ 1,17 00:33 વીડિયો , 'મને ટાઇફૉઇડ થયો છે, પણ...' અભિજિત દીપકેએ શું જાહેરાત કરી? , અવધિ 0,33 02:09 વીડિયો , મુંબઈમાં યુવતીએ પોલીસની ગાડીને અટકાવી , અવધિ 2,09 01:33 વીડિયો , ગુજરાતમાં આ તારીખ સુધી અતિભારે વરસાદની શક્યતા , અવધિ 1,33 00:46 વીડિયો , નવસારીમાં એટલો વરસાદ પડ્યો આ કે રેલવે-ટ્રૅક ધોવાયો , અવધિ 0,46 00:41 વીડિયો , વલસાડમાં એવો વરસાદ પડ્યો કે પ્રાણીઓ તણાયાં, વાહનો ડૂબ્યાં , અવધિ 0,41 00:49 વીડિયો , 'ભાજપના મતદારો આવીને માફી માગતા હતા' , અવધિ 0,49 00:34 વીડિયો , દરિયાની વચ્ચે બોટોમાં ચીન અને ફિલિપાઇન્સના સૈનિકો વચ્ચે અથડામણ , અવધિ 0,34 02:46 વીડિયો , સોનમ વાંગચુકનાં પત્ની અને તેમનો સપૉર્ટ પિલર ગીતાંજલિ અંગમો કોણ છે? , અવધિ 2,46 02:15 વીડિયો , E20 પેટ્રોલ : જૂની ગાડીઓના ઇન્શ્યૉરન્સ ક્લેઇમ પાસ નહીં થાય? , અવધિ 2,15 શૉર્ટ વીડિયોનો અંત

In further updates, LIVE Live, ‘વિરોધ કરે એ વિદ્યાર્થીઓની ધરપકડ થાય છે, 30-40 દિવસ સુધી જામીન નથી મળતા’ LIVE Live, LIVE ટીવી જોવા માટે અહીં ક્લિક કરો ધર્મેન્દ્ર પ્રધાનનું રાજીનામું રાષ્ટ્રપતિએ સ્વીકાર્યું, કોને મળ્યો શિક્ષણ વિભાગનો હવાલો 3 કલાક પહેલા બીબીસી વિશેષ ધર્મેન્દ્ર પ્રધાનનું રાજીનામું રાષ્ટ્રપતિએ સ્વીકાર્યું, કોને મળ્યો શિક્ષણ વિભાગનો હવાલો 3 કલાક પહેલા તામિલનાડુના મુખ્ય મંત્રી વિજયની ફિલ્મ 'જનનાયગન' કેવી છે? 4 કલાક પહેલા ધર્મેન્દ્ર પ્રધાનનું રાજીનામું રાષ્ટ્રપતિએ સ્વીકાર્યું, કોને મળ્યો શિક્ષણ વિભાગનો હવાલો 3 કલાક પહેલા વડા પ્રધાન મોદીએ અડધી રાતે ઇન્સ્ટાગ્રામ પર બબ્બે વીડિયો કેમ મૂકવા પડ્યા? 25 જુલાઈ 2026 વરસાદ અપડેટ : ગુજરાતમાં પૂર જેવી સ્થિતિ, અનેક લોકો ફસાયા, હજુ અતિભારે વરસાદની આગાહી 24 જુલાઈ 2026 સોનમ વાંગચુક અને કૉક્રોચ જનતા પાર્ટી વચ્ચે અંતર આવ્યું છે? નડ્ડાના હાથે ઉપવાસ તોડવા પર ઊઠી રહ્યા છે સવાલ 24 જુલાઈ 2026 જંતર-મંતર : રીલ્સ, મીમ્સ અને રાજકારણનું મિલન, લાઠીચાર્જ અને ટિયર ગૅસ વચ્ચે Gen Zનો વિરોધ કરવાનો નવો અંદાજ 24 જુલાઈ 2026 ભારતના બંધારણમાં અપાયેલો વિરોધ કરવાનો અધિકાર શું છે, નાગરિકો વિરોધ કરવા ઉપરાંત શું કરી શકે? 24 જુલાઈ 2026 પુરુષોના પગના વાળ મામલે ટોક્યોમાં કેમ થઈ રહ્યો છે વિવાદ 22 જુલાઈ 2026 સૌથી વધુ વંચાયેલી સ્ટોરીઝ 1 ધર્મેન્દ્ર પ્રધાનને આખરે રાજીનામું કેમ આપવું પડ્યું, તેની પાછળનાં પાંચ કારણો 2 ગુજરાતમાં હજુ ત્રણ દિવસ વરસાદનું જોર રહેશે, કયા જિલ્લામાં રેડ ઍલર્ટ અપાયું? 3 'સેક્સ એ ભેટ નહીં', આ મહિલાઓ હવે માત્ર રૉમાંસ જ પસંદ કેમ નથી કરતી? 4 ગુજરાતનાં શહેરો વારંવાર ચોમાસામાં કેમ પાણીમાં ડૂબી જાય છે? 5 એક હજાર દીનારની રોટલી અને માનવમાંસનું વેચાણ: એ દુકાળ જેણે એક ખલીફાને મહેલનો સામાન વેચવા મજબૂર કરી દીધા 6 Weather Update: ગુજરાતમાં સૌરાષ્ટ્ર-કચ્છમાં ચોમાસું સક્રીય, ક્યાં ભારે વરસાદની આગાહી? 7 સોનમ વાંગચુક અને કૉક્રોચ જનતા પાર્ટી વચ્ચે અંતર આવ્યું છે? નડ્ડાના હાથે ઉપવાસ તોડવા પર ઊઠી રહ્યા છે સવાલ 8 ધર્મેન્દ્ર પ્રધાનનું રાજીનામું રાષ્ટ્રપતિએ સ્વીકાર્યું, કોને મળ્યો શિક્ષણ વિભાગ��ો હવાલો 9 ધર્મેન્દ્ર પ્રધાન : પેપરલીકનો વિરોધ કરતાં જેમને ક્યારેક માર પડ્યો હતો, આજે એમણે રાજીનામું આપવું પડ્યું 10 આગામી 3 દિવસ ગુજરાત માટે ભારે: 23 થી 27 જુલાઈ વચ્ચે આ જિલ્લાઓમાં પડશે ભારેથી અતિભારે વરસાદ BBC News, ગુજરાતી બીબીસી વિશ્વાસપાત્ર કેમ? title: Sudarshan Reddy: బీఆర్‌ఎస్‌ మాజీ ఎమ్మెల్యే పెద్ది సుదర్శన్‌రెడ్డి పరిస్థితి విషమం
body: Here's what's trending across India right now:

వరంగల్‌: నర్సంపేట మాజీ ఎమ్మెల్యే, బీఆర్‌ఎస్‌ నేత పెద్ది సుదర్శన్‌రెడ్డి (Sudarshan Reddy) తీవ్ర అస్వస్థతకు గురయ్యారు. హనుమకొండలోని నివాసంలో ఉండగా ఇవాళ ఉదయం ఆయనకు గుండె పోటు రావడంతో కుటుంబ సభ్యులు హుటాహుటిన ఆసుపత్రికి తరలించారు. పరీక్షించిన రోహిణీ ఆసుపత్రి వైద్యులు సుదర్శన్‌రెడ్డి పరిస్థితి విషమంగా ఉన్నట్టు చెప్పారు. బీఆర్‌ఎస్‌ కార్య నిర్వాహక అధ్యక్షుడు కేటీఆర్‌, మాజీ మంత్రి హరీశ్‌రావు బీఆర్‌ఎస్‌ నేతలు వరంగల్‌ బయల్దేరారు. మాజీ ఎంపీ వినోద్‌ కుమార్‌, పలువురు నేతలు ఆసుపత్రికి చేరుకున్నారు.

Adding to this, గమనిక: ఈనాడు.నెట్‌లో కనిపించే వ్యాపార ప్రకటనలు వివిధ దేశాల్లోని వ్యాపారస్తులు, సంస్థల నుంచి వస్తాయి. కొన్ని ప్రకటనలు పాఠకుల అభిరుచిననుసరించి కృత్రిమ మేధస్సుతో పంపబడతాయి. పాఠకులు తగిన జాగ్రత్త వహించి, ఉత్పత్తులు లేదా సేవల గురించి సముచిత విచారణ చేసి కొనుగోలు చేయాలి. ఆయా ఉత్పత్తులు / సేవల నాణ్యత లేదా లోపాలకు ఈనాడు యాజమాన్యం బాధ్యత వహించదు. ఈ విషయంలో ఉత్తర ప్రత్యుత్తరాలకి తావు లేదు.

title: Hina Khan, Rubina Dilaik discuss Aamir Khan's third marriage: ‘Humare samaj mein bahut acha nahi maana jata’
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Superstar Aamir Kha n has been making headlines in recent weeks over his marriage to girlfriend Gauri Spratt . The star's personal life became the centre of a spirited debate between Rubina Dilaik and Hina Khan on The Point of View, where the two actors shared contrasting opinions on his third marriage.

Adding to this, Aamir Khan and Gauri Spratt got married in an intimate ceremony in Mumbai on July 5. While Hina argued that many people in society still do not view multiple marriages favourably, Rubina maintained that a superstar's personal life sometimes influences public perception and, at times, even their professional journey.

Meanwhile, Hina and Rubina weighed in on Aamir’s personal life during the latest episode of Rubina’s talk show, The Point of View. Joined by their respective husbands, Rocky Jaiswal and Abhinav Shukla , the couples discussed whether a superstar’s personal life has any bearing on their professional success.

Notably, During the discussion, Rocky brought up the criticism surrounding Aamir's third marriage and asked for their opinions. While Rubina argued that a superstar's personal life can influence their films and career, Hina maintained that an star's personal choices should have no bearing on their professional success.
As per the latest buzz, Hina questioned, "Us hisaab se to Aamir Khan ki koi movie hi nahi chalni chahiye (By that logic, none of Aamir Khan's films should have worked)."

In further updates, At that point, Rubina argued that Aamir's life had never been surrounded by any major row. Here, Hina disagreed and shared, "Ye kya koi kam row hai (Is that any less of a row)," referring to his third marriage with Gauri Spratt.

On top of that, Explaining her point further, Hina shared, "Aam aadmi to yahi sochega na kya yaar phir se shadi kar raha hai? isko bhi chor diya (The average person would think, 'Seriously, he's getting married again?' and 'Did he leave her too?)”
Rubina interrupted, saying, "Why are we judging?"

title: Ryan Gosling to Star in Marvel’s Ghost Rider Movie
body: Here's what's trending across India right now:

Variety Plus Icon Click to expand the Mega Menu Plus Icon Click to Expand Search Input Variety Plus Icon Read Next: ‘Matchbox’ Trailer: John Cena Stars in Toy Car Action Movie From Apple TV Home Movie News Jul 25, 2026 6:07pm PT Ryan Gosling to Star in Marvel’s Ghost Rider Movie
Adding to this, Ryan Gosling is finally joining the Marvel Cinematic Universe.

Meanwhile, The “Project Hail Mary” star will play Ghost Rider in a new standalone movie, Marvel Studios exec Kevin Feige revealed onstage from Hall H at San Diego Comic Con. The movie will be directed by Shawn Levy and is slated to rollout in 2028.

Notably, Levy is no stranger to the world of Marvel, most of late directing and producing the smash hit “Deadpool & Wolverine” movie. He and Gosling also of late collaborated on the soon-to-release “Star Wars” movie “Star Wars: Starfighter,” which Levy also directed and in which Gosling stars. That movie is due to rollout on May 28, 2027. Related Stories Steven Spielberg Praises 'Jurassic Park' Star Sam Neill as 'Exceptionally Collaborative' in Tribute to Late Star: He 'Will Never Be Forgotten'

As per the latest buzz, “I’m having the greatest flashback vibes here, because I was here two years ago when we showed ‘Deadpool & Wolverine,'” Levy shared upon taking the Hall H stage alongside Gosling and Feige. “I’ll never forget that night, because I was introduced to the greatest followers. Gosling is the absolute shit. I say that with tremendous respect. We spent a lot of time last year making ‘Starfighter,’ and the opportunity as Ryan started talking about this character, I was like, ‘Bro let’s ride.’ We’ll see you in 2028!” Popular on Variety

In further updates, Gosling will be the second star to play the Spirit of Vengeance in a movie after Nicolas Cage played the fiery motorcycle rider in two Sony movies. The character was also portrayed by Gabriel Luna as the Robbie Reyes version of the comic book character in the Marvel-ABC series “Agents of SHIELD.” Luna was set to reprise the role in a standalone series for Hulu, but that project was scrapped in 2019 .

On top of that, Cage first starred in Sony’s “Ghost Rider” movie in 2007, playing motorcycle stuntman Johnny Blaze. In the comics and his origin story movie, Johnny sells his soul to the devil Mephisto in order to cure his father’s cancer. As with any deal with the devil, Mephisto does cure Johnny’s dad, but he still dies in a stunt accident. Johnny then becomes bonded to a supernatural demon called the Spirit of Vengeance and is able to transform into a flaming, skeletal biker. He also has super-strength, wields fiery chain whips and can force someone to experience the emotional pain they’ve inflicted upon others with his Penance Stare.
Cage reprised his role for the 2011 sequel, “Ghost Rider: Spirit of Vengeance,” but reviews for both films were mostly negative.

The company settled a disputed claim with Rocket Capital NY by issuing 26,581 shares against an agreed $500,000 amount, with the related New York lawsuit to be dismissed and mutual releases in place. title: Shagufta Ali recalls hiding stage 3 breast cancer, says fear of losing work kept her silent: ‘My savings ran out too’
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Veteran star Shagufta Ali has always remained very open about discussing the most difficult period of her life. From having stage three breast cancer to running out of money due to her health issues and those of her father’s, she claims to have shouldered all responsibilities without having to ask for any kind of assistance from anyone. When it comes to discussing how she was criticised for her financial problems, she has remained very honest about it too. In a recent interview with Siddharth Kannan, the star discussed why she hit her diagnosis.

Adding to this, 'I never begged for money': Shagufta Ali on cancer battle and financial struggles. Why she hid her breast cancer diagnosis Shagufta opened up that she kept her stage 3 breast cancer diagnosis a secret because she was scared it would affect her career. She shared the industry's attitude at the time left her feeling she had no choice.

Meanwhile, Asked why she never spoke about it, Shagufta replied, “Uss zamaane mein uss cheez ko ye kaha jaata tha ki nahi nahi nahi nahi nahi, batana nahi batana. Bilkul don't talk about it and don't speak about it. Nahi toh kaam milna. Phir wahi darr, dara diya ki kaam nahi milega. Phir industry waale aisa karne lagte hain, aisa behave karte hain, aisa behave karte hain. Toh nahi bataya tha maine (Translation: Back then, the prevailing attitude was—no, no, no—you simply couldn't talk about it. You absolutely weren't supposed to mention it; otherwise, you wouldn't get work. There was that fear—the threat that work would dry up. People in the industry would start acting or behaving in certain ways. So, I didn't say anything.)"

Notably, In the tough days that followed, she shared that she had to sell her jewellery and car in order to survive, but she made it clear that she did not have to sell her house. Till today, she finds herself comfortable traveling in an auto rickshaw for work and medical purposes.

As per the latest buzz, She further talked about how people questioned her about having no savings. “ When I started facing difficulties from 2017 onwards, people began questioning me, saying, 'Didn't you have any savings?' Of course I did. I had plenty of savings, and that's exactly what I used all these years. I'm not an Ambani, Tata or Adani, am I? It's not like my money would never run out. How much savings do you think I could possibly have? I'm a television star. I'm the only earning member in my house. Those savings had to cover illnesses, everyday expenses, groceries, maintaining the household, everything.”

In further updates, What she could not understand is why her inability to ask for help irked people, as she did not get why it mattered to them what she did with her savings. She shared that she did not use her money to gamble in night clubs, drink excessively, live a luxurious life or go out partying. What irritated her more was having to answer them about her spending habits and she wanted to know just what the problem was. Speaking about the persistent queries about what happened to her savings, she explained that all of it was spent on her hospital bills.

On top of that, Shagufta Ali, who was going to be seen in Yeh Rishta Kya Kehlata Hai as the soon-to-release two-year leap in the serial, is now not a part of the show anymore. She had been chosen to portray the role of the grandma of Aaditya Gupta, but she had to back out of the project owing to health issues. The makers have replaced her with Neelu Vaghela.

Adding to this, फेसबुक टि्वटर कैंसिल बुकमार्क Follow us फेसबुक टि्वटर कैंसिल 'क्योंकि सास भी कभी बहू थी' से घर-घर में फेमस हुईं एक्ट्रेस अपरा मेहता टीवी इंडस्ट्री का बड़ा नाम हैं. उन्होंने अपने करियर में काफी तरक्की हासिल की. लेकिन पर्सनल लाइफ में उन्होंने काफी उतार-चढ़ाव देखे हैं. शादी के 23 साल बाद एक्ट्रेस के पति दर्शन जरीवाला ने उनसे रिश्ता तोड़ दिया था. एक्ट्रेस अब सिंगल लाइफ जी रही हैं.

Meanwhile, 'हॉटरफ्लाई' संग बातचीत में अपरा मेहता ने अपनी शादी और पर्सनल लाइफ को लेकर बात की. अपरा मेहता ने एक्टर दर्शन जरीवाला से साल 1980 में शादी की थी. इस शादी से कपल की एक बेटी है. मगर शादी के 23 साल बाद साल 2003 में अचानक दर्शन ने अपरा से अलग होने का ऐलान कर दिया और घर छोड़कर चले गए. बता द��ं कि उनका तलाक नहीं हुआ है.

Notably, अब अपरा ने बताया है कि पति के छोड़ने पर उन्होंने दूसरी शादी क्यों नहीं की? दूसरी शादी पर अपनी राय देते हुए अपरा बोलीं- तलाक बहुत होते हैं. इसलिए मैं कहती हूं कि तुरंत ही दूसरी शादी नहीं करना चाहिए. अंत में फिजिकल लव ही मायने रखता है, तो जैसे मर्द को प्यार मिल सकता है, वैसे महिला को भी मिल सकता है.

As per the latest buzz, अपरा आगे बोलीं- डिस्टेंस मैंटेन करके भी किसी के साथ फिजिकल रिलेशनशिप रख सकते हैं. इसलिए मैं लोगों से कहती हूं कि तुरंत ही दूसरी शादी मत करो. जो चीज पहले ही वर्क नहीं हुई, तो इसकी क्या गारंटी है कि दूसरी बार चल जाएगी. वैसे भी जब कुछ सालों किसी के साथ जिंदगी बिताई होती है, तो किसी और के साथ जिंदगी कैसे बिताई जाती सकती है?
In further updates, अपरा ने बताया कि एक दिन अचानक उनके पति घर छोड़कर चल गए थे. मगर आज भी उनके लिए घर के दरवाजे खुले हैं. वो वापस आ सकते हैं. लेकिन उन्हें ये भी एहसास है कि शायद वो अब कभी वापस ना आएं.

On top of that, अपरा मेहता की बात करें तो पति के छोड़ने के बाद उन्होंने अकेले ही बेटी की परवरिश की और अपने करियर को भी संवारा. अपरा ने ये भी बताया कि पति से अलग होने के बाद भी सास संग उनका रिश्ता काफी स्ट्रॉन्ग है.

Foto: Reprodução/Youtube O Santos deve contar com Neymar no duelo contra a Chapecoense, neste sábado (25), pelo Campeonato Brasileiro . No entanto, o camisa 10 pode não estar em campo no compromisso seguinte, diante da Universidad Central, pela partida de volta dos playoffs da Copa Sul-Americana.
Adding to this, A informação foi divulgada pelo jornalista Fábio Sormani , em publicação na rede social X.

Meanwhile, Segundo Sormani, o planejamento da comissão técnica é utilizar Neymar normalmente no confronto diante da Chapecoense, na Vila Belmiro. Já para o duelo de terça-feira, também na Vila, contra a Universidad Central, o camisa 10 seria preservado.
Notably, “Neymar joga hoje contra a Chapecoense, mas não jogará terça-feira contra a UCV no jogo da volta pela Sul-Americana na Vila Belmiro”, publicou o jornalista.
As per the latest buzz, Até o momento, o Santos não confirmou oficialmente a informação.

In further updates, Caso a informação se confirme, a ausência de Neymar faria parte de um planejamento para controlar a carga física do jogador, que voltou recentemente após um período de recuperação.
On top of that, A comissão técnica comandada por Cuca tem adotado cautela com a utilização do camisa 10, buscando evitar um desgaste excessivo neste retorno aos gramados.

O possível descanso de Neymar também é favorecido pela situação do confronto na Copa Sul-Americana. No jogo de ida, disputado na Venezuela, o Peixe venceu a Universidad Central por 4 a 1 e abriu boa vantagem na disputa por uma vaga nas oitavas de final.

title: വീട്ടിൽ വന്നാൽ ട്യൂഷൻ നൽകാം; വിദ്യാർഥിനിയോട് മോശം പെരുമാറ്റം, അധ്യാപകനെ കൈകാര്യം ചെയ്ത് വിദ്യാർഥികൾ
body: Here's what's trending across India right now:

ഭൂമിശാസ്ത്ര വിഭാഗത്തിൽ അധ്യാപകനായിരുന്ന സന്ദീപ് ദത്തയെയാണ് വിദ്യാർഥിനിയുടെ പരാതിയെ തുടർന്ന് പൊലീസ് അറസ്റ്റ് ചെയ്തത്. ഫോണിലൂടെ മോശമായി സംസാരിക്കുകയും അനുചിതമായി പെരുമാറുകയും ചെയ്തിരുന്നതായി പരാതിയിൽ പറയുന്നു. വീട്ടിൽ വന്നാൽ സൗജന്യമായി ട്യൂഷൻ നൽകാമെന്നും അധ്യാപകൻ വിദ്യാർഥിനിക്ക് വാഗ്ദാനം നൽകി. വീട്ടിൽ വരാൻ വിസമ്മതിച്ചാൽ പരാജയപ്പെടുത്തുമെന്ന് ഭീഷണിപ്പെടുത്തിയതായും വിദ്യാർഥിനി പരാതിയിൽ പറയുന്നു. തുടർന്ന് ഗോബർദംഗ പൊലീസ് സ്റ്റേഷനിലാണ് പെൺകുട്ടി പരാതി നൽകിയത്.

Adding to this, പൊലീസിൽ പരാതി നൽകിയതിനൊപ്പം കോളജിലെ സീനിയർ വിദ്യാർഥികളോടും യുവതി അധ്യാപകന്റെ പ്രവൃത്തികൾ പറഞ്ഞു. ഇതോടെയാണ് വിദ്യാർഥികൾ ��ധ്യാപകനെ ചൂൽ കൊണ്ട് അടിക്കുകയും ചെരുപ്പുമാല ധരിപ്പിച്ച് പരേഡ് ചെയ്യിക്കുകയും ചെയ്തത്. ഇതിന്റെ ദൃശ്യങ്ങൾ സമൂഹമാധ്യമങ്ങളിൽ പ്രചരിക്കുന്നുണ്ട്.

Adding to this, প্রাপ্ত রিপোর্ট অনুযায়ী, গতকাল, মঙ্গলবার মর্নিং স্কুল চালু নিয়ে এক বিশেষ বিজ্ঞপ্তি প্রকাশ্যে এসেছে। যেখানে স্পষ্ট জানানো হয়েছে, পূর্ব মেদিনীপুর জেলা প্রাথমিক বিদ্যালয় সংসদের অধীনে, যে সমস্ত প্রাথমিক বিদ্যালয়ের সকল শিক্ষক-শিক্ষিকা জনগণনা ট্রেনিংয়ে যোগ দেবেন, সেই সকল স্কুলগুলোতেই কেবলমাত্র ‘ট্রেনিংয়ের দিন’ মর্নিং স্কুল করানো হবে। একাধিক জেলায় জনগণনার কাজের জন্য সরকারি স্কুল থেকে শিক্ষক শিক্ষিকাদের নানারকম সমস্যা হচ্ছে। পঠনপাঠন ঠিকভাবে না হওয়ায় ক্ষোভ প্রকাশ করছেন অভিভাবকরা। যদিও বাকি জেলাগুলিতে এই নিয়ে কিছুই জানানো হয়নি।

Meanwhile, বেহাল দশা উচ্চ প্রাথমিক বিদ্যালয়গুলোতে, ঝাড়গ্রামের গোপীবল্লভপুর ব্লকে বাবু ডুমরু হাইস্কুলে পঞ্চম থেকে দশমে ভূগোলের একজনই শিক্ষক। প্রথমে তাঁকেও বিএলও ডিউটি দেওয়া হয়েছিল সেই সময় পড়াশোনায় বেশ ক্ষতি হয়েছিল পড়ুয়াদের। আর এবার জনগণনার কাজের জন্য একাদশ–দ্বাদশে ইতিহাসের শিক্ষকদের ডাকা হচ্ছে। এই বিষয়ে স্কুলের প্রধান শিক্ষক অভিযোগ করছেন, ‘শিক্ষকরা ক্রমাগত স্পেশাল ইনটেনসিভ রিভিশন বা জনগণনার কাজ করলে স্কুলে পড়াবেন কারা?’ যদিও এই নিয়ে কোনো প্রতিক্রিয়া পাওয়া যায়নি।
Notably, আরও পড়ুন: বাসস্থানের প্রমাণ হিসেবে আধার কার্ড গ্রহণ করা যাবে, বড় রায় কলকাতা হাইকোর্টের

As per the latest buzz, রাজ্যের বিভিন্ন স্কুলে এই অচলাবস্থার কথা শুনে স্কুলশিক্ষা প্রতিমন্ত্রী কৌশিক চৌধুরী জানিয়েছেন, ‘আমি খোঁজখবর নিচ্ছি। পড়াশোনা বন্ধ না করেই দু’টি কাজ কী ভাবে সম্পন্ন করা যায়, তার বিকল্প পথ খুঁজে বার করতে হবে।’ তবে আপাতত পূর্ব মেদিনীপুর জেলা প্রাথমিক বিদ্যালয় গুলির ক্ষেত্রে মর্নিং স্কুলের নোটিস দেওয়া হয়েছে।

In further updates, আরও Purba Medinipur School আরও খবর “ভারত থেকে নেপালে আসছে অবৈধ পাকিস্তানিরা” বিরাট দাবি কাঠমাণ্ডুর ধর্মেন্দ্রর পদত্যাগের পর প্রতিক্রিয়া দিলেন ওয়াংচুক, ‘ককরোচদের জয়’ বলে আখ্যা অভিজিতের সারপ্লাস ট্রান্সফারে নয়া সিদ্ধান্ত শিক্ষা দফতরের, নবীন শিক্ষকদের জন্য এবার বড় সুযোগ কোনও মহিলা বাদ যাবে না অন্নপূর্ণা যোজনা থেকে! বিধায়কদের বড় দায়িত্ব দিলেন মুখ্যমন্ত্রী সব প্রবীণই কি ন্যূনতম পেনশন পাবেন? নীরবতা ভাঙল সরকার ‘সেবাশ্রয়’-র নামে রিসর্ট দখল করে তোলাবাজির অভিযোগ! ফের অভিষেকের বিরুদ্ধে FIR ভিড় ঠেলাঠেলির দিন শেষ! হাওড়া স্টেশনে খুলছে ২৪ নম্বর প্ল্যাটফর্ম, দিনক্ষণ ঘোষণা রেলের ইস্তফা দিলেন ধর্মেন্দ্র প্রধান খবর পড়ুন যেটা আপনার জন্য জরুরি !!

title: Ranvir Shorey, Tara Deshpande disappointed with Dharmendra Pradhan's resignation: ‘Streets held hostage’
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Ranvir Shorey had opinions about Dharmendra Pradhan's resignation. Ranvir Shorey reacts to Dharmendra Pradhan’s resignation Ranvir expressed shock with a GIF on X (formerly Twitter) when news broke out about Pradhan’s resignation from his post after nationwide protests. “And in one swift move the Modi govt has managed to win over none of its enemies, and disenchant a lot of its supporters. #masterstroke,” he wrote, with clapping emojis.

Adding to this, When an X user asked him if he thought Pradhan should not have resigned over the NEET paper leak, Ranvir clarified his stance. Referencing the protests led by the CJP, he wrote, “Yes, but should have done it before the streets were held hostage. Now it seems supporters will not be heard, but “cockroaches” on streets will!”

Meanwhile, Re-posting an X post made by Zoho founder Sridhar Vembu expressing his disappointment, Tara had something similar to say. “Sad. A minister who served many portfolios over a long career. He played a leading role in implementing the Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana, which expanded LPG connections to millions of low-income households,” read a portion of her tweet.

Notably, She further wrote, “He oversaw reforms such as the PAHAL direct benefit transfer for LPG subsidies and the Hydrocarbon Exploration and Licensing Policy (HELP). He saw the Steel industry through trying times in the Pandemic. Even in education if you look at the work he did outside of NEET paper leaks it was solid. His act of resignation is to be respected.”

As per the latest buzz, Meanwhile, Bollywood celebrities have been vocal in their support of the movement online and offline, both. Prakash Raj , Shabana Azmi and Hanumankind have turned up at the Delhi protests, while Sonakshi Sinha, Vijay Verma and others were vocal in their support online. Gurfateh Pirzada, Pratibha Ranta, Shalini Pandey and many others attended the Mumbai protests.

In further updates, After news of Pradhan’s resignation broke, many took to social media to praise the CJP, Wangchuk and Gen Z for leading the movement after alleged irregularities during the NEET exam and the paper leak. Celebrities such as Kamal Haasan , Chinmayi Sripaada and others have also been vocal in their opinions.

title: Ramayana trailer leaks online again after postponement; fans urge makers to release promo of Ranbir Kapoor, Yash film
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

The trailer for Nitesh Tiwari’s Ramayana Part 1 has been leaked online again after the San Diego Comic-Con showcase. The footage featuring Ranbir Kapoor , Sai Pallavi, Yash, and Rakul Preet Singh has been leaked online in bits and pieces numerous times, so much so that an X (formerly Twitter) user was even able to piece together all of it. Followers have since urged the makers to rollout the trailer.

Adding to this, Ranbir Kapoor plays the lead in Nitesh Tiwari's Ramayana films. (PTI) Ramayana trailer leaks online again Ramayana’s trailer was screened at the Pratham Sankalp event in New Delhi on July 18, after which a few clips of it were leaked online. Clips found their way online after it was screened at Comic Con on July 24. Since then, an X user has even pieced together the leaked clips into a 2-minute trailer. While it’s unknown if that’s how the final trailer will look, some followers were impressed. As for others, they urged the makers to drop the trailer after the leak.

Meanwhile, “We stayed awake all night waiting for the movie trailer, but at the very last moment, they broke their promise and canceled the trailer. You did great job this is what we want,” commented one person under the post. “#Ramayan trailer leaked to be honest it look more like adipurush but we have to wait and watch. Ranveer in ANIMAL has negative impact on this movie as RAM. I didn't get goosebumps,” wrote another X user, reacting to the leaked clips.

Notably, “Looks very good and promising. Atleast this leak is not shot on potato camera,” wrote one Redditor, while another commented, “Avatar level vfx, Dialogues are good, Some things need some more work. I believe they will fix. Airavat loooks so peak.” “It’s disappointing that a movie as big as #Ramayana couldn’t protect its trailer from leaking before the official rollout. The makers should have had stronger security measures in place. Months of hard work deserve better than an online leak,” read one post.

As per the latest buzz, Early on Friday morning, producer Namit Malhotra posted on Instagram to announce it had been pushed to a later date. “Today is a very special moment for our "Ramayana", my dream of taking Ramayana to the world is now a reality with our partnership with Sony Pictures Entertainment. In light of the above we will be launching our trailer now globally at a later date,” he wrote.

In further updates, “In over 100 years of indian cinema this will become a moment of great pride where Ramayana will be shown to the entire world like any major global Hollywood movie. This is special as it opens the door for people of the world to discover the richness of our culture and our stories with renewed pride and enthusiasm,” his note further read.

On top of that, “I thank all the followers and the believers of Ramayana to help make this happen. The youth of our country are our future, let's all do the best we can to protect our future,” he wrote at the end of the note.

title: 2027 वर्ल्ड कप के लिए भुवनेश्वर कुमार पर दांव लगाना चाहते हैं आर अश्विन, अनुभवी पेसर
body: Here's what's trending across India right now:

भारतीय क्रिकेट टीम ने अब अपनी नजरें 2027 वनडे वर्ल्ड कप पर टिका दी हैं. टीम संयोजन को लेकर लगातार चर्चा हो रही है और कई पूर्व खिलाड़ी अपनी राय रख रहे हैं. इंग्लैंड दौरे पर भारतीय गेंदबाजी उम्मीद के मुताबिक असर नहीं छोड़ सकी. इसी बीच पूर्व भारतीय ऑलराउंडर रविचंद्रन अश्विन ने अनुभवी तेज गेंदबाज भुवनेश्वर कुमार का समर्थन किया है. अश्विन का मानना है कि चयनकर्ताओं को 2027 वनडे वर्ल्ड कप के लिए भुवनेश्वर कुमार पर जरूर विचार करना चाहिए.

Adding to this, आर अश्विन ने अपने यूट्यूब चैनल पर कहा, 'भुवनेश्वर कुमार को 2027 वनडे वर्ल्ड कप के लिए कंसीडर करना चाहिए. वह पहले से ज्यादा फिट दिखते हैं. उनके पास अनुभव है और वह पावरप्ले के साथ-साथ डेथ ओवरों में भी शानदार गेंदबाजी करते हैं. वह निचले क्रम में उपयोगी बल्लेबाजी भी कर सकते हैं. इसलिए मुझे लगता है कि उन्हें एक और मौका मिलना चाहिए.'

Meanwhile, भुवनेश्वर कुमार ने आईपीएल 2026 में रॉयल चैलेंजर्स बेंगलुरु के लिए शानदार गेंदबाजी की. उन्होंने नई गेंद से अपनी स्विंग का कमाल दिखाया और डेथ ओवरों में सटीक यॉर्कर से बल्लेबाजों को लगातार परेशान किया. पूरे सीजन में उन्होंने 16 मैचों में 28 विकेट अपने नाम किए. वह पर्पल कैप की रेस में भी आखिर तक बने रहे और सिर्फ एक विकेट से यह सम्मान हासिल करने से चूक गए.
Notably, यह भी पढ़ें- रोहित शर्मा की साइन की हुई जर्सी पाकर खुश हुए जोस बटलर, इंस्टाग्राम पोस्ट में कही दिल जीतने वाली बात

As per the latest buzz, भुवनेश्वर कुमार ने अपना आखिरी वनडे मुकाबला साल 2022 में दक्षिण अफ्रीका के खिलाफ खेला. उस मैच में उ��्होंने आठ ओवर में 67 रन दिए. इसके बाद टीम मैनेजमेंट ने 50 ओवर के क्रिकेट में उनसे दूरी बना ली. हालांकि, उन्होंने टी20 टीम में कुछ समय तक अपनी जगह बनाए रखी. टी20 वर्ल्ड कप 2022 के बाद उनका अंतरराष्ट्रीय सफर भी धीमा पड़ गया और न्यूजीलैंड के खिलाफ टी20 सीरीज उनके करियर की आखिरी अंतरराष्ट्रीय सीरीज रही.
In further updates, यह भी पढ़ें- 2027 वर्ल्ड कप के लिए भारत का तेज गेंदबाजी आक्रमण तय? अतुल वासन ने चुने 5 पेसर

On top of that, भुवनेश्वर कुमार ने घरेलू क्रिकेट और आईपीएल में लगातार अच्छा प्रदर्शन किया है. उनकी फिटनेस और अनुभव को देखते हुए आर अश्विन ने साफ कहा कि भारतीय टीम को 2027 वनडे वर्ल्ड कप की तैयारियों में इस अनुभवी तेज गेंदबाज के नाम पर गंभीरता से विचार करना चाहिए. अब यह देखना दिलचस्प होगा कि चयनकर्ता उनकी इस सलाह को कितना महत्व देते हैं.

Meanwhile, ∙ വീണ്ടും ഉപപ്രധാനമന്ത്രി, അമിത് ഷാ പുനഃസംഘടന സംബന്ധിച്ച ചർച്ചകളിൽ ഏറ്റവും മുന്നിലുള്ളത് ഉപപ്രധാനമന്ത്രി സ്ഥാനമാണ്. അമിത് ഷാ ഉപപ്രധാനമന്ത്രിയാകുമെന്നാണ് ഊഹാപോഹങ്ങൾ. എങ്കിൽ ബിജെപിയുടെ ഭാവി നേതൃത്വത്തിലേക്കും ഇതു ചൂണ്ടുപലകയാണ്. അക്കാര്യത്തിൽ ആർഎസ്എസ് നിലപാട് നിർണായകമാകും. ബംഗാൾ പിടിച്ചെടുത്തതും ടിഎംഎസിയും എഎപിയും അടക്കമുള്ള പാർ‌ട്ടികളെ പിളർത്തിയതും പാർട്ടിയിൽ അമിത് ഷായുടെ സ്വാധീനം കൂട്ടിയിരുന്നു. അതിനിടെ അയോധ്യ സ്വർണക്കൊള്ളയുടെ വാർത്തകൾ പുറത്തു വന്നത് ഈ ദിശയിലുള്ള നീക്കങ്ങളുടെ ആക്കം കുറച്ചുവെന്നും പറയുന്നു. വാജ്പേയി സർക്കാരിന്റെ അവസാന വർഷങ്ങളിൽ എൽ.കെ. അഡ്വാനിയെ ഉപമുഖ്യമന്ത്രി ആക്കിയിരുന്നു. എന്നാൽ‌ പുനഃസംഘടനയ്ക്കു പകരം പ്രധാന്റെ രാജി മാത്രമാണെങ്കിൽ മറ്റു തീരുമാനങ്ങൾ മാറ്റി വച്ചേക്കാം.

Meanwhile, आज जुलाई महीने का चौथा शनिवार है। रिजर्व बैंक ऑफ इंडिया की गाइडलाइन के अनुसार आज के दिन बैंक कर्मियों की छुट्टी रहती है। बता दें, महीने के पहले, तीसरे और पांचवें शनिवार को बैंक खुला रहता है। जबकि दूसरे और चौथे शनिवार को बैंक कर्मियों की छुट्टी रहती है।

Notably, आज भले ही बैंक की सर्विसेज उपलब्ध नहीं रहेंगी। लेकिन इसके बाद भी नेट बैंकिंग और मोबाइल बैंकिंग से काम किए जा सकेंगे। अगर किसी ग्राहक को बैलेंस चेक करना है, यूपीआई से पैसा ट्रांसफर करना, बिल का भुगतान करना है तो वह नेट बैंकिग या फिर मोबाइल बैंकिंग के जरिए ये काम आसानी से कर पाएगा। इसके अलावा अकाउंट खोलने से लेकर, केवाईसी अपडेट, लोन के एप्लीकेशन, डेबिट कार्ड के लिए रिक्वेस्ट आदि भी आज जनरेट किया जा सकेगा।

As per the latest buzz, जुलाई के महीने में आज शनिवार और कल रविवार के बाद अब कोई भी छुट्टी बैंक कर्मियों की नहीं है। अगस्त के महीने में कई प्रमुख त्योहार हैं जिसकी वजह से देश के अलग-अलग हिस्सों में कई दिनों तक बैंक बंद रहेंगे।

In further updates, सबसे पहली छुट्टी 4 अगस्त को है। इस दिन केर पूजा की वजह से बैंक अगरतला में नहीं खुलेंगे। 8 अगस्त को गंगटोक में बैंक कर्मियों की छुट्टी रहेगी। 13 अगस्त को इम्फाल में भी बैंक बंद रहेंगे। इस दिन यहां कोई काम काम बैंक की शाखाओं में नहीं होगा।

On top of that, 15 अगस्त को स्वतंत्रता दिवस होने की वजह से देश भर के बैंकों में कोई काम-काज नहीं होगा। श्रीनगर से लेकर लखनऊ, हैदराबाद, तिरुअनंतपुरम् तक और अहमदाबाद से लेकर अरुणाचल प्रदेश तक हर जगह बैंक कर्मियों की छुट्टी रहेगी।

19 अगस्त को अगरतला बंद रहेंगे। 25 अगस्त को कोच्चि, विजयवाड़ा और तिरुअनंतपुरम् में बैंक कर्मियों की छुट्टी रहने वाली है। इन इलाकों में बराफात का त्योहार मनाया जाएगा। वहीं, देश के कुछ हिस्सों में 26 अगस्त को यह त्योहार मनाया जाएगा। 28 अगस्त को रक्षा बंधन का त्योहार है। इस दिन भी देश के कई हिस्सों में बैंक बंद रहेगा।

title: Vishal Dadlani reveals why he'll miss the Indian Idol Season 16 grand finale: 'I wish them all the very best'
body: Here's what's trending across India right now:

Dubai: After months of performances, emotional moments and standout stories, Indian Idol Season 16 wraps up with its grand finale this Sunday, July 26. Built around the season's theme, Yaadon Ki Playlist, the finale promises an evening of music and nostalgia as one of six finalists takes home the trophy.

Adding to this, Anshika Chonkar, Jyotirmayee Nayak, Manraj Veer Singh, Myscmme Bosu, Suhail Sufi and Tanishk Shukla have all made it to the final stage, having impressed both judges and viewers throughout the season.

Meanwhile, Judges Vishal Dadlani, Shreya Ghoshal and Badshah have guided the contestants throughout, with host Aditya Narayan steering the show through every milestone. Together, they've watched the finalists grow into confident performers across the season.

Notably, Vishal Dadlani, who won't be present for the finale itself, shared his thoughts ahead of the big night. "This season has been filled with remarkable talent and some truly memorable performances," he shared. "What has impressed me the most is the contestants' willingness to learn, push their boundaries, and evolve with every performance. Reaching the grand finale itself is a huge achievement, and each of our top 6 finalists has collected their place through hard work and dedication. I am really sad that I couldn't be a part of the finale due to a prior commitment, but I wish them all the very best, and I hope they continue making music long after Indian Idol."

As per the latest buzz, Shreya Ghoshal reflected on how far the contestants have come. "Watching these contestants grow throughout the season has been such a beautiful experience," she shared. "Each one has brought their own individuality, sincerity, and love for music to the stage, making this journey truly memorable. No matter who lifts the trophy, I hope they continue believing in themselves because this is only the beginning of a wonderful musical journey."

In further updates, Host Aditya Narayan echoed that sentiment. "Every season of Indian Idol is special, but watching these contestants grow from their very first audition to the grand finale has been incredibly rewarding," he shared. "This season, Yaadon Ki Playlist has given us so many unforgettable memories, and I'm sure the grand finale will be a fitting celebration of everything we've experienced together. I wish all six finalists the very best and can't wait for audiences to witness an evening filled with extraordinary music and heartfelt moments."

On top of that, Alongside judges Shreya Ghoshal and Badshah, the finale will feature a lineup of special guests including Usha Uthup, Udit Narayan, Papon, Kumar Sanu, Shehnaaz Gill and Urmila Matondkar.
The Indian Idol Season 16 grand finale airs Sunday, July 26, on Sony Entertainment Television, and will also stream on SonyLIV.

title: Overjoyed Sonakshi Sinha celebrates Dharmendra Pradhan’s resignation, apologises to Gen Z student protestors: ‘Salute’
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Dharmendra Pradhan , the Union Minister of Education, quit on Saturday amid widespread demonstrations by students across India against purported irregularities in entrance tests, including NEET-UG. The news has brought happiness to many students, social activists, and even some celebrities supporting this movement. One of them is Sonakshi Sinha , who posted on Instagram and uploaded a playful video congratulating all those who have hailed this moment as a significant win for students.

Adding to this, Sonakshi Sinha celebrates Dharmendra Pradhan’s resignation with hilarious video: ‘Millenial sathiya gayi hai’ Sonakshi has been one of the celebrities voicing their opinions in recent weeks. She came out in support of Sonam Wangchuk during his indefinite hunger strike and condemned the lathi and tear gas attack on students during the Sansad March on July 20.

Meanwhile, In a video shared on social media after the resignation, Sonakshi looked visibly thrilled. She even did sit-ups while apologising to Gen Z for not taking them seriously. She shared, “Bhai aap jaante nahi ho aapne aaj kya kiya hai. I am an artist, bro, but Gen Z is the art. Main pata hai bahut halke mein leti hoon Gen Z ko. Maine socha kya hai, jaake karte hain, thak jaate hain, kuch nahi hoga inse. Uske liye salute. Salute! Look at me now, I want to be you, I want to be Gen-Z. What have y'all done? Unbelievable.”

Notably, The translation means, "Brother, you have no idea what you’ve achieved today. I’m an artist, bro, but Gen Z is the art. You know, I used to underestimate Gen Z. I’d think, "They just do things on a whim, get tired, and nothing really comes of it." But I take my hat off to you for this. Salute! Look at me now—I want to be you; I want to be Gen Z. What have you all done? It’s unbelievable.."

As per the latest buzz, View this post on Instagram Why Dharmendra Pradhan resigned Dharmendra Pradhan stepped down following weeks of protests led by the Cockroach Janta Party (CJP), which demanded accountability over alleged examination irregularities and called for his resignation.

In further updates, In his resignation letter to Prime Minister Narendra Modi , Pradhan wrote that reforming India's education system had been his lifelong mission and serving the country's youth had always been a moral responsibility. Referring to the alleged irregularities in the NEET-UG examination held on May 3, 2026, he shared the government had ordered a CBI inquiry, cancelled the exam, revealed a fresh examination and decided to shift the test to CBT mode from next year. He added that the government's immediate priority is ensuring that over 20 lakh students can appear for the re-examination without any further difficulties.

On top of that, Pradhan also shared he had accepted responsibility from the very beginning and remained committed to ensuring that deserving students do not suffer because of the examination mafia. He maintained that the results revealed on July 16 reflected the hard work of meritorious students. At the same time, he expressed disappointment over what he described as attempts to mislead students during the protests. Explaining his decision, Pradhan shared he was deeply saddened by recent developments and did not want the row to create more confusion or be misused in any way.

title: ‘The resistance must continue’: Shabana Azmi says students have won first battle after Dharmendra Pradhan's resignation
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Following weeks of student protests against the irregularities in competitive exams, Union Minister of Education Dharmendra Pradhan tendered his resignation on Saturday, stating that he does not want the row related to NEET-UG exam to impact the future of students. His resignation has raised many emotions across the country, including veteran star Shabana Azmi , who did take part in Jantar Mantar demonstrations and had met CJP leader Abhijeet Dipke in New Delhi, shared that it is a very important moment for the student movement.

Adding to this, Shabana Azmi calls Dharmendra Pradhan's resignation only the beginning. Shabana Azmi calls Pradhan's resignation only the beginning In an interview to PTI, Shabana expressed her pride in the youth who were staging protests for several weeks now, and whose perseverance brought about a significant success. "So proud of our youth. I am truly humbled. Thank you for showing us that our Constitution is our greatest strength,” she shared.

Meanwhile, Shabana has been one of the strongest voices from the movie industry who has come out in support of the ongoing protests. Earlier this week, she participated in the student-led protest, the Chalo Sansad march, at Jantar Mantar in New Delhi, where she condemned the police's actions against protesters. The students were lathi-charged, and tear gas shells were thrown at them.

Notably, Though she was scheduled to participate in the protest in Mumbai, the star had to stay behind because of swine flu. Nevertheless, Shabana believes that the protest campaign should not stop at the resignation of the minister. "It is the first step towards the students' victory. But the resistance must continue till the educational system is overhauled and all demands are met," she added.

As per the latest buzz, View this post on Instagram Dharmendra Pradhan resigns Dharmendra Pradhan resigned following weeks of protests organised by the Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) that were demanding accountability and wanted him to resign for any irregularities in the examination. In his letter of resignation, Dharmendra wrote to Prime Minister Narendra Modi that he had regarded reforms in education as his lifetime objective and taking care of youth had been his moral obligation in his public life.

In further updates, Pradhan went on to say that after the irregularities were revealed in the NEET-UG examination of 3rd May 2026, the government had ordered a CBI inquiry into it, cancelled the examination, revealed a re-examination, and decided to conduct the examination in CBT mode from the next year. Moreover, the immediate concern of the government is to help the 20 lakh plus students appear in the new examination without any problems.

On top of that, Pradhan shared that he had assumed responsibility right from the start, and he was determined that the deserving students should not face any difficulties because of the examination mafia. Besides this, he shared that the results revealed on 16th July were the result of the hard work of the meritorious students.

At the same time, however, Pradhan voiced his disappointment in people’s efforts to mislead the students during the protest. In explaining his resignation, the politician shared that recent developments had saddened him deeply and that he did not want the situation to cause any further confusion among students or be misused.

Dass es nur ein Testspiel ist, dass nicht alle Stars dabei sein werden – kann die Vorfreude alles nicht trüben. Nur Trainer Daniel Scherning hat von Berufs wegen Bedenken.

Adding to this, Der SV Wehen Wiesbaden hat gegen den FC Bayern München eine der besten Bilanzen im deutschen Profifußball. Nur eine einzige Niederlage kassierten die Hessen gegen den Rekordmeister – und die fiel auch noch äußerst knapp aus. Vor rund elf Monaten glich der Drittligist nach einem 0:2-Rückstand in der ersten Runde des DFB-Pokals gegen die Münchner noch aus und kassierte erst in der Nachspielzeit den entscheidenden Hieb zur 2:3-Niederlage durch einen gewissen Harry Kane.

Meanwhile, Zur Wahrheit gehört auch, dass dies das bislang einzige Aufeinandertreffen der beiden Klubs war. Dass sich beide nach knapp einem Jahr nun am Samstag (15.30 Uhr) bereits wiedersehen, dürfte daher noch keine Ermüdungserscheinungen hervorrufen. Trainer Daniel Scherning freut sich jedenfalls auf ein ausverkauftes Stadion.

Notably, Ungleich größer ist die Vorfreude naturgemäß bei denen, die dann auch wirklich gegen den Rekordmeister kicken dürfen. Ben Nink, der gerade als Vize-Europameister von der U19-EM zurückgekehrt ist und vor seinem ersten Senioren-Jahr beim SVWW steht, dürfte einen besonders hohen Puls haben. "Ich bin von Kind auf Bayern-Fan", sagt der 19-Jährige. "Daher ist das für mich persönlich umso bedeutender."

As per the latest buzz, Auf die großen Stars wie Harry Kane oder Michael Olise dürfen Followers und Spieler nach der Weltmeisterschaft noch nicht hoffen, die Nationalspieler haben noch ein wenig Urlaub. Doch auch das B- oder C-Team der Münchner kommt noch mit sehr viel Qualität. "Man muss in solchen Spielen schneller im Kopf sein. Das ist der größte Unterschied, dass das Spiel deutlich schneller ist", sagt Nink.

In further updates, Sein Trainer blickt dem Vergleich gerade deshalb mit gemischten Gefühlen entgegen. Für Mannschaft und Umfeld sei das natürlich ein Highlight. "Auch wenn die Nationalspieler zum Großteil sicherlich nicht auflaufen werden, kann man davon ausgehen, dass sich noch ein paar andere bei Vincent Kompany ins Rampenlicht spielen wollen", befürchtet Scherning. "Wir werden wahrscheinlich auf eine hochmotivierte Mannschaft treffen, wo viele Spieler auf dem Platz sind, die ihre Chance nutzen wollen." Deshalb sei es für ihn als Trainer "nicht das allerallerbeste Testspiel", sagt Scherning.

On top of that, Sein Fokus liegt allein auf der bestmöglichen Vorbereitung für das erste Saisonspiel gegen Preußen Münster zwei Wochen später. Das gerade abgeschlossene Trainingslager bewertet er bis auf die Verletzung von Florian Hübner dabei als Erfolg . Wohin die Reise in der Saison dann gehen wird, da wagt er noch keine Prognose. "Wir wollen eine gute Rolle spielen. Wir wissen aber auch, dass wir nicht die besten Möglichkeiten in dieser Liga haben, wenn man das Wirtschaftliche und auch das Umfeld nimmt. Aber wir fühlen uns in dieser Rolle sehr wohl und wollen ambitioniert und zielstrebig in die Saison reingehen", sagt Scherning.

Youngster Nink formuliert es deutlich unverblümter: "Natürlich ist das Ziel, dass wir aufsteigen. Wir werden alles daran setzen, das Ziel wahrnehmen zu können." Der Test gegen die Bayern dürfte also auch eine erste vorsichtige Standortbestimmung sein.

title: ‘The Odyssey’ Was Made for Imax 70mm. Good Luck Watching It That Way
body: Here's what's trending across India right now:

While Nolan’s adaptation of Homer’s epic is available on thousands of screens around the world, there are only 41—including 25 in the US—that can offer it in full Imax 70mm glory. Many of those are sold out for weeks. Levels of FOMO are off the charts.

Adding to this, That’s partly because The Odyssey is the first feature movie shot entirely on Imax movie with Imax cameras. For the uninitiated, the Imax movie format takes an already large 65-mm movie negative and runs it through the camera horizontally, resulting in an image 15 perforations wide compared to the standard 5 perf. When projected on a giant Imax screen, the resulting image, with a squarish aspect ratio of 1.43:1, is enormous and incredibly sharp, creating a far more immersive experience than standard cinema offerings. This is real Imax, according to followers of the format, which was first introduced in 1970.

Meanwhile, Imax, though, comes in a variety of flavors: digital formats in 2K and 4K resolutions, xenon and laser light configurations, on top of the classic 15/70-mm. Outside of a select few, most digital Imax theaters crop the image to a wider 1.90:1 aspect ratio and project on screens a good deal smaller than a traditional Imax giant theater.

Notably, “This all started in 2008 when Imax introduced its first digital system,” says James Hyder, who managed the Smithsonian Air and Space Museum’s Langley Imax theater in the ’80s, and ran the giant-screen industry journal LF Examiner from 2008 to 2021. Imax did not respond to requests for comment.

As per the latest buzz, The company’s foray into digital exhibition with a 2K-resolution dual-projector system was part of a long-planned shift. Executives wanted to expand beyond museums and science centers and into big theater chains, which didn’t always have the screen real estate the traditional Imax experience demands.

In further updates, The result, though, has been notably different Imax experiences depending on what type of Imax theater you’re in. Especially as major theater chains have invested in PLF (Premium Large Format) screens that rely on Dolby Vision or other systems, it’s hard to know what you’re going to get, or if Imax is even your best bet.

On top of that, Complicating things further for The Odyssey is that it’s available in so many premium formats—six, altogether—that the movie’s official website includes a guide to their various strengths and aspect ratios. While it disambiguates between 70mm Imax and “regular” Imax, it doesn’t capture the wide range of what those “regular” experiences can entail.

“It's a disservice to their customers, and it's basically trading on a reputation for real giant screens that used to be what Imax stood for,” Hyder says of the lack of clarity and consistency around how Imax is implemented.

title: Exclusive: ISL side SC Delhi sign Diamond Singh & three more young talents
body: Here's what's trending across India right now:

The capital club have secured the services of Diamond Singh , Irengbam Newtan , Kamgouhao Doungel and Ringsangmi Lungharwo , continuing their long-term investment in youth as preparations gather pace for the new campaign.

Adding to this, All four players are regarded among the country’s top prospects in their respective age groups. Three of them have come through the AIFF FIFA Talent Academy , while two of them have represented India in the national youth setup.
Meanwhile, The latest additions also underline SC Delhi’s commitment to building for the future, with the club set to compete in the Durand Cup for the first time in its history .
Notably, Unlike several ISL clubs, where young signings often spend their first few seasons with the reserve team or on the fringes of the senior squad, SC Delhi have opted for a different approach.

As per the latest buzz, The capital club have decided to loan out three of their new recruits to clubs in the lower divisions of Indian football, allowing them to gain regular first-team minutes in a competitive environment before returning to challenge for places in the ISL squad. The strategy is one the club successfully implemented last season with India youth international Mohammed Kaif , who spent the campaign on loan and is now set to be integrated into SC Delhi’s first team for the 2026-27 season.

In further updates, The signings underline the long-term vision SC Delhi have embraced since being acquired by the B.C. Jindal Group two years ago. Under head coach Tomasz Tchorz, the club has consistently placed its faith in young Indian talent, handing several youngsters significant first-team opportunities last season and continuing that approach during the 2026 summer transfer window.
On top of that, Among the four recruits, Thokchom Diamond Singh is regarded as one of the brightest talents in Indian football.

The 16-year-old attacking midfielder from Manipur is a product of the AIFF FIFA Talent Academy and a regular member of Bibiano Fernandes’ India U-17 squad , having represented the country at the AFC U-17 Asian Cup 2026 .

title: ಗೃಹಲಕ್ಷಿ ಯೋಜನೆ ಕುರಿತು ತಪ್ಪು ಮಾಹಿತಿ: ಅರ್ಜಿ ಸಲ್ಲಿಕೆ ಪ್ರಕ್ರಿಯೆ ಇನ್ನೂ ಆರಂಭವಾಗಿಲ್ಲ!

Adding to this, ಹಾಗಾಗಿ ಗೃಹಲಕ್ಷ್ಮಿ ಯೋಜನೆಗೆ ಮರು ಅರ್ಜಿ ಸಲ್ಲಿಕೆ ಹಾಗೂ ಕೆವೈಸಿ ಇನ್ನೂ ಆರಂಭವಾಗಿಲ್ಲ. ಆದರೂ ಕೆಲವೊಂದು ಯೂಟ್ಯೂಬರ್ಸ್ ಗೃಹಲಕ್ಷಿ ಯೋಜನೆಗೆ ಮರು ಅರ್ಜಿ ಸಲ್ಲಿಸಬೇಕು ಮತ್ತು ಕೆವೈಸಿ ಮಾಡಬೇಕು ಎಂದು ಸಾಮಾಜಿಕ ಜಾಲತಾಣಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಸುಳ್ಳು ಸುದ್ದಿಗಳನ್ನು ಪ್ರಚಾರ ಮಾಡುತ್ತಿರುವುದರಿಂದ ಫಲಾನುಭವಿಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಗೊಂದಲ ಉಂಟಾಗಿದೆ.

Notably, ಹಾಗಾಗಿ ಯಾರೂ ಗೊಂದಲಕ್ಕೆ ಒಳಗಾಗಬೇಕಿಲ್ಲ.ಯೋಜನೆ ಅರ್ಜಿ ಹಾಗೂ ಕೆವೈಸಿ ಪ್ರಾರಂಭದಲ್ಲಿ ಮಾಹಿತಿಯನ್ನು ಪ್ರಕಟಿಸಿಲಾಗುದು ಎಂದು ಇಲಾಖೆಯ ಮೂಲಗಳಿಂದ ತಿಳಿದು ಬಂದಿದೆ

title: Lights, Camera, Activism: Films That Captured A Generation’s Fire
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Long before hashtags and marches, Hindi cinema was already telling stories of young people who refused to look away. Here is a look back at the films that turned youthful anger into action, and still manage to light a fire every time we revisit them.

Adding to this, A still from Aanand L Rai's movie Raanjhanaa Raanjhanaa (2013) Sonam Kapoor Ahuja and Abhay Deol in a still from Raanjhanaa. Director: Aanand L. Rai | Cast: Dhanush, Sonam Kapoor, Abhay Deol

Meanwhile, Better known as a heartbreak story, Raanjhanaa quietly doubles as a portrait of campus politics once its heroine, Zoya, becomes a Delhi University student leader. Her romance with Akram, a young activist trying to reform the system from within, is loosely drawn from the real culture of DU’s student union elections, where politics has long been a young person’s first taste of public life, and where personal conviction and ambition are never easy to tell apart.
Notably, Director: Prakash Jha | Cast: Amitabh Bachchan, Saif Ali Khan, Deepika Padukone, Manoj Bajpayee

As per the latest buzz, A college principal stands by fairness as his students split into rival camps in this drama about India’s education system. The movie was directly inspired by the real Supreme Court ruling upholding caste-based reservation quotas, a decision that had already set off student protests across the country in the years before the movie rolled out, making its campus unrest feel less like fiction and more like a rerun of the headlines.
In further updates, Directors: Vikas Bahl, Nitesh Tiwari | Cast: Irrfan Khan, Sanath Menon, Rohan Grover, Naman Jain

On top of that, A gang of school kids refuse to let a local politician take away their friend’s stray dog. What was written as a simple children’s story turned into one of Hindi cinema’s most memorable protests, staged entirely at school and colony level. The kids organise a citywide march, some of them down to their underwear, and go on a hunger strike, proving that a movement does not need adults or ideology to actually work.
Director: Rakeysh Omprakash Mehra | Cast: Aamir Khan, Siddharth, Sharman Joshi, R. Madhavan, Alice Patten

title: Hamare Baarah director Kamal Chandra to shoot his next film in hometown Agra; says Hindi belt is the space to be in
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Filmmaker Kamal Chandra, who hails from Agra and is a Bhartendu Natya Academy (BNA) pass-out, is gearing up for the rollout of his next movie Aryabhatt Ka Zero . His last rollout, Hamare Baarah (2025), was shot in Lucknow .

Adding to this, Filmmaker Kamal Chandra The director, who was of late in his hometown for a recce of his next movie—a love story—on his visit to the state capital tells HT City, “My directorial debut Ab Dilli Door Nahin was shot in the national capital. Since then, I shot my last rollout with Annu Kapoor in Lucknow, and my next two releases have been shot in Dehradun (Uttarakhand) and Panna (Madhya Pradesh). I am drawn to Hindi heartland locations, realistic stories, and a deeper connection with the audience.”
Meanwhile, View this post on Instagram A post shared by Sufi Khan (@philosufiofficial)
Notably, In Lucknow, he shot at BNA, where he passed out in 2004. He also assisted director Sudhir Mishra on Daas Dev (2018) and Ratnaa Sinha’s directorial debut, Shaadi Mein Zaroor Aana (2017).

As per the latest buzz, "I have been writing a love story for a long time, which is now complete. I want to shoot in my hometown as the soul of the story is from Uttar Pradesh. Filmmakers have shot in Agra but have been fascinated only by the Taj Mahal ; I want to show a different side of the city that has not been explored yet," he says, adding, "This winter, we plan to go on floors. My visit to Agra was for that initial recce and final story touch-up. Hindi belt is the space to be in! But before that, I plan to rollout Flower Walli , a time-travel movie, which we have shot in Panna."

In further updates, Excited about his next rollout, he says, “Earlier it was titled Boondi Raita , but we later procured the current title, Aryabhatt Ka Zero . Star Neeraj Sood plays Aryabhatt and Himansh Kohli plays his son. It’s a slice-of-life story of a mohalla boy and his journey from zero se hero, but with a very special twist.”
On top of that, View this post on Instagram A post shared by Kamal Chandra (@kamalchandraofficial)

Filled with confidence, he says, "I have made my movie with heart and soul. I am sure everyone does that, but I know that my movie is high on emotional quotient, and I believe that the audience will connect with it. I believe it deserves a chance as it has a very rooted story, and thankfully we are living in an era when content is over and above everything and stories are the hero of the movie."

title: Deepika Singh on why Delhi will always be home: I know these roads better than google maps
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Some people need an app to find their way around Delhi, but TV star Deepika Singh remembers every turn. On a recent visit to the Capital to meet family, the star found herself correcting her own car’s GPS in real time. “I know the roads better than Google,” she laughs, pointing out that after nearly fifteen years of living in Mumbai, Delhi, clearly, never left her system.

Adding to this, Deepika Singh in Connaught Place That instinct traces back to Paharganj, where Deepika grew up long before the world knew her as Sandhya. Her path from an Air Force school student to a bank employee to, quite unexpectedly, a ramp model plays out like a script no one wrote on purpose. “There was one contestant short, and the money being offered was good. I was very adventurous and courageous,” she recalls of the walk that put her face in every newspaper the next morning and, eventually, on television screens across the country. “Delhi ne mujhe opportunities bahut di hai”

Meanwhile, If the city gave her a career, she says it also gave her a spine. “Delhi has made me a very strong person, because of the ups and downs I faced and the type of conditioning I have gotten here.” Even her old solo trips to tuition, she jokes, came with an unofficial curriculum. “Self-defence training meri apne aap hi hogayi thi.”

Notably, Fame hasn’t touched her shopping habits either. Dilli Haat and Sarojini Nagar remain non-negotiable, and her food map still runs from Roshan Di Kulfi in Karol Bagh to the chole bhature at Sitaram’s in her own Paharganj. “Dilli mein raat ke 3-4 baje bhi laziz khaana milta hai,” she says. Even her dance reels, the ones the internet can’t stop watching, come with the same disclaimer. “I know I’m not dancing well, I’m just creating a vibe, because I’m still a Delhi girl at heart.”

As per the latest buzz, She credits the city’s mixed culture for the rest. “Delhi girls are the strongest, sabko collar pakadna aata hai. In Mumbai, everyone is running with the speed of the local, but Delhi feels very homely.”

In further updates, That warmth showed mid-conversation, as followers kept walking up for photos and she obliged every single time. “Dilli waale dil se hi milte hain,” she smiled, adding that this affection is exactly what keeps her going.

title: ‘Please shut up’: Vir Das has a message to naysayers saying ‘nothing will happen’ after Dharmendra Pradhan's resignation
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Star-comedian Vir Das made numerous posts on his social media in response to Dharmendra Pradhan's resignation as Union Education Minister following nationwide protests. Apart from re-posting a video of one of his old sets, Vir also had a fresh message for the naysayers who think nothing can change in the country.

Adding to this, Vir Das made multiple posts after news broke about Dharmendra Pradhan's resignation. Vir Das cracks jokes, has a message for naysayers Vir re-posted Pradhan’s resignation on his X (formerly Twitter) and wrote, “FRAAANDS!!!!” He then joked, “Tonight on your TV screens at 9pm. Many versions of “You know we here at ______ have been saying all along….” He also criticised those who are sitting on the fence or will change sides, writing, “I hope you like pancakes, you’re about to see a lot of flipping.”

Meanwhile, “Hate is yelled, love is felt,” wrote Vir while posting a video from one of his sets. “You realise that hate is yelled, while love is felt,” he says in the video, adding, “And trust, that it will always outlast the hate. And that’s not even history, that’s just basic Harry Potter. But if you are ever at the receiving end of hate or feel like your nation is lost in it, from my family to you, I just want you to know that love is always playing right underneath. You just can’t hear it in the darkness. You gotta hang out till sunlight. You will hear it. It’s soft, but it’s not weak.”

Notably, In a video posted on his Instagram, Vir reacted to the news of Pradhan’s resignation. “Now celebrate this quickly because you don’t know what’s going to happen tomorrow. Something will happen. At your office, in your family, on your WhatsApp group, in your friends’ circle, there will always be one who will say ‘nothing will happen’ ‘but in India…’ ‘this is how it is only’,” he shared in the video. Slamming them, he added, “This is how it is only. To that person. Please, shut up. Just shut up. Just for today.”
As per the latest buzz, View this post on Instagram A post shared by Vir Das (@virdas)

In further updates, The Cockroach Janata Party, which began as a social movement, demanded the resignation of Pradhan as well as a few other benefits for the students affected by the NEET exams. The protest spread to other cities in large numbers after activist Sonam Wangchuk was whisked away by the police during his hunger strike, and the protesters in the Chalo Sansad march on July 20 were met with lathi and tear gas. Pradhan revealed his resignation on July 25.

On top of that, Despite having a Master's degree in Journalism and over a decade of experience in print and digital media as a field reporter and sub-editor at organisations such as The Times of India and Reader's Digest, Neeshita Nyayapati remains a movie buff first and a Chief Content Producer second. She fell in love with movies in childhood and believes nothing matches the magic of watching a good movie that moves you with a warm tub of popcorn in hand. Her love for writing about cinema follows that. Come Friday, you'll find her at her happy place, the movies, catching the latest rom-com or masala offering, for reviews or otherwise. As for the rest of the week, she's here reporting the juiciest news in Telugu, Tamil, Malayalam, Kannada and Hindi or bringing out the best of celebs in interviews. While her niche is Telugu cinema, Neeshita likes to dabble in a little bit of everything to stay up to date. From movie announcements to scandals and hard news angles, she has explored it all. A good book, a comforting cup of hot chocolate, puppy kisses and a stunning beach view are all she needs to unwind. Her passion for biking and travelling has taken her to various places across the country. She has found peace in everything from the frozen lakes of Gangtok to the coffee plantations of Coorg and the dense forests of Bandipur, to the monasteries of Darjeeling.
